judgments.reason: The paper describes the BOLD Moments fMRI companion dataset (BMD) using the same videos, not the EEG data in EMD, so it is related work rather than this dataset's data paper.
judgments.paper_title: Modeling short visual events through the BOLD moments video fMRI dataset and metadata

judgments.reason: Paper introduces the EEG Moments Dataset (EMD): 128-channel EEG and eye tracking from 6 participants viewing 1,102 videos, matching the dataset's authors and description.
judgments.paper_title: A large dataset of human EEG responses to short naturalistic videos for studying dynamic visual event processing
